capabilities.name: A-SourceBlockLedger und deterministische Unit-Planung

knownLimitsRisks: Block ownership is necessary but does not prove semantic atomization completeness.
capabilities.activationReason: The V2 product runner invokes the source plan before any A model call.

capabilities.name: Begrenzte Qwen-A-Klassifikation und Atomisierung
capabilities.purpose: Klassifiziert deterministisch geplante A-Units mit servereigenen IDs und atomisiert operative Aussagen source-bound.
knownLimitsRisks: Model-valid output is not automatically fachlich optimal.
Unseen structures remain a generalization gate.
Multiple same-role evidence occurrences must be rebound under the current semantic contract before a predecessor batch is reusable.
Administrative record obligations and conditional applicability statements require source-bound deterministic normalization when a model omits mandatory labels.
Parenthetical object exclusions require a separate source-bound EXCLUDED effect while retaining the containing object requirement.
Predicate-free internal object list governors and continued item-leading blocks require explicit source-bound provenance without weakening the unanchored-list fail-closed boundary.
Embedded list governors are bounded to immediately following subordinate list items; unseen layouts remain subject to holdout validation.
Partial predecessor answers are never trusted as PASS and must be rebound to the identical source plan and current validator before reuse.
Complementary duplicate envelopes are merged only for the same expected operative unit ID and still require complete current-contract source validation.

Legacy component-shaped requirements are lifted only for wholly legacy, source-bound CLAUSE responses without logical list segments or a single complete continued-list segment without governing context; mixed, multi-segment or unbound shapes remain fail-closed.
PERIL_OR_DAMAGE is normalized from an invalid component alias only when its exact source-bound label contains an explicit causal damage relation; ambiguous labels remain fail-closed.
capabilities.activationReason: Validated on the complete known 1+9 fixture and activated for controlled customer production in V3.8.0.

capabilities.name: Dynamisches A-Manifest und Rollen-/Atomisierungsregeln
capabilities.purpose: Materialisiert A-Kategorien, Requirements und Komponenten in Quellreihenfolge mit Objekt, Gefahr, Wirkung, Rolle, Scope, Wert, Limit und Geltung.
knownLimitsRisks: Known 1+9 manifest quality is regression evidence, not a holdout proof.
Occurrence-bound V11 role materialization still requires an unseen expert-labeled holdout for generalization proof.
Internal object-list provenance is validated structurally and on the known 1+9 failure unit, but remains subject to unseen-layout holdout validation.
Embedded list-governor groups are bounded by server-owned segment roles and hierarchy; their generalization remains unproven without an unseen expert-labeled holdout.
External governing context may move with an owned shared list governor only into its immediately subordinate item requirements and remains fully source-validated.
A legacy OBJECT alias inside a conditional equivalence definition is relabeled as a peril only when the response already declares PERIL_OR_DAMAGE; unseen structures remain a holdout gate.
Causal peril aliases require an exact source-bound damage-plus-causal-marker label; terminal aliases without that evidence remain invalid.
A legacy LIST response is lifted only when one continued-item segment owns the complete ordered unit block sequence and no external governor exists.
capabilities.activationReason: Current V2 runner consumes this manifest directly.

capabilities.name: Automatisches A-Integritätsgate
capabilities.purpose: Prüft terminale Blockabdeckung, Batch-/Responsebindung, Manifestkonsistenz und operative Fehlklassifikationsrisiken vor B.
knownLimitsRisks: A technical PASS does not prove fachliche completeness or 99 percent.
Coordinated peril atomization is intentionally syntax-bounded; unseen enumeration forms remain a holdout question.
capabilities.activationReason: Required by the controlled V2 B launch contract.

capabilities.name: Komponentenweise Qwen-B-Gegenstückprüfung

resourceImpact.runtime: HIGH for a cold run; measured seeded rematerialization of 204 batches took 87,781 ms with 361/363 requirements reused; 15/15 rescue rows rematerialized in 24 ms with zero model calls
resourceImpact.gpu: Qwen bursts only for non-seeded requirements

knownLimitsRisks: A PASS batch proves contract validity, not agreement with Gold.
Deterministic local-model output can repeat the same malformed or schema-invalid answer; bounded schema-specific repair must remain fail-closed.

Identity-core modifier normalization is allowed only for a positive MATCH or COUNTERPART_WITH_DIFFERENCE context, identical server-bound candidate IDs and explicit differences limited to scope, condition, value, limit, deductible or temporal validity; RELATED_ONLY remains excluded.
Cross-plan reuse is allowed only after complete seed binding, byte-identical row comparison and current single-row revalidation.

Explicit-exclusion normalization is restricted to one PERIL_OR_CAUSE identity core, an existing COVERAGE_EFFECT, one cited server-bound clause with explicit exclusion wording and exactly one configured general peril-equivalence group; unrelated clauses, ambiguous cores and uncited evidence remain fail-closed.
